question:
In how many different ways can the letters of the word APPLE be arranged?
(a) 120
(b) 60
(c) 24
(d) 30

In how many ways can 5 people be seated around a circular table?
(a) 120
(b) 24
(c) 60
(d) 25

In how many ways can a committee of 3 members be selected from 7 people?
(a) 210
(b) 21
(c) 35
(d) 42

How many 3-digit numbers can be formed using the digits 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 if no digit is repeated?
(a) 125
(b) 60
(c) 10
(d) 120

How many diagonals does a hexagon have?
(a) 15
(b) 6
(c) 9
(d) 12

In how many ways can 4 boys and 3 girls be arranged in a row so that all the girls sit together?
(a) 5040
(b) 720
(c) 144
(d) 1440

In a party, 10 people shake hands with each other exactly once. How many handshakes take place?
(a) 90
(b) 45
(c) 100
(d) 20

What is the area of a circle of radius 7 cm? (Take π = 22/7)
(a) 44 cm²
(b) 154 cm²
(c) 308 cm²
(d) 49 cm²

What is the circumference of a circle of diameter 14 cm? (Take π = 22/7)
(a) 22 cm
(b) 88 cm
(c) 44 cm
(d) 154 cm

A tangent PQ at a point P of a circle of radius 5 cm meets a line through the centre O at a point Q such that OQ = 13 cm. What is the length of PQ?
(a) 12 cm
(b) 13 cm
(c) 8.5 cm
(d) 18 cm

What is the area of a sector of angle 90° of a circle of radius 14 cm? (Take π = 22/7)
(a) 154 cm²
(b) 616 cm²
(c) 308 cm²
(d) 77 cm²

What is the length of an arc that subtends an angle of 60° at the centre of a circle of radius 21 cm? (Take π = 22/7)
(a) 44 cm
(b) 22 cm
(c) 66 cm
(d) 11 cm

A chord of length 16 cm is drawn in a circle of radius 10 cm. What is the distance of the chord from the centre?
(a) 8 cm
(b) 6 cm
(c) 4 cm
(d) 12 cm

The radii of two circles are 19 cm and 9 cm. What is the radius of the circle whose circumference is equal to the sum of the circumferences of the two circles?
(a) 28 cm
(b) 10 cm
(c) 14 cm
(d) 21 cm
